description: Atomically update an asset-set plan node's authoring fields and persist a complete draft manifest proposal; requires expected revisions from the current session. Configure before asking the user to approve.

brief.description: Creative brief for the whole set — subject, style, palette.

desiredPurpose.description: What the assets are for, e.g. 'iOS tab icons'.

expectedFlowRevision.description: Flow revision from the current session — stale values are rejected to prevent lost updates.

expectedManifestRevision.description: Manifest revision the draft builds on; 0 for the first proposal.

label.description: Short asset-set name, e.g. 'app icon set'.

manifest.description: Complete draft manifest object the backend will validate and persist.

planNodeId.description: The asset_set plan node's id in the graph.

requestedCount.description: How many assets the manifest should propose.

requestedFormats.description: Output formats: ["png"] or ["png","svg"] — svg adds local vectorisation.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: update_asset_set_plan
